decisions.reason: As a line extension of the firm’s established laser-marking business in a growing, R&D-intensive firm with evident slack, this product is likely to meet aspirations well enough to be retained.
Because it is close to the core coding offer and the firm is expanding and investing, management is likely to keep it unless early sales clearly fall below aspiration levels.

Although somewhat more uncertain than the other launches, it still fits the firm’s core technologies and customer needs, and the firm’s size and slack make withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.
